)

)

)

)

  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

)

)

)

  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "userAgent" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."mediaAsset" (

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."mediaAssetPerformer" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "mediaAssetId" text NOT NULL,
  "performerId" text NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("mediaAssetId", "performerId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."mediaCategory" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,

  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,

  "usedAt" timestamptz,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."performer" (

  "legalName" text,
  "notes" text,
  "phone" text,

  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."performerDocument" (
  "bucketName" text NOT NULL,
  "contentType" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "documentType" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,

  "objectKey" text NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."performerLibraryFolder" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "id" text NOT NULL,

  "normalizedName" text NOT NULL,
  "parentId" text,

)

)

  "lastErrorMessage" text,

)

  "clientType" text DEFAULT 'WEB' NOT NULL,

  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,

  "ipAddress" text,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,

)

  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "verifiedAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "firstName" text,

  "lastName" text,
  "locale" text DEFAULT 'en-US' NOT NULL,

  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."workspace" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "onboardingStatus" text DEFAULT 'WELCOME' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'CREATOR' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "role" text DEFAULT 'OPERATOR' NOT NULL,

  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
